name: traits-dev
description: Monorepo for traits.dev voice profile and behavioral policy tooling.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @traits-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/cli build && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/vercel build && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/mcp build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @traits-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/core exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/vercel typecheck && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/mcp typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @traits-dev/core test && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/cli test && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/vercel test && pnpm --filter @traits-dev/mcp test
scripts.release:ci: pnpm build && pnpm docs:build && pnpm release
